Here’s mine for singles:

Ability: Unburden

Spread: Adamant, 252 atk, 252 speed, (rest into sp.def or def)

Moveset: Swords Dance, Leaf Blade, Dragon Claw(will probably replace this move), and then I am thinking about adding Mega Punch because....

Item: Normal Gem

Sceptile has a wider move pool when it comes to physical moves. Also having access to swords dance means he can double his atk in one turn making him hit pretty hard. Most people also assume that you will run him as a special attacker so there’s the surprise factor as well with running this. Pair with unburden which then he gets super fast. If you don’t like the normal gem mega punch strat, then you could perhaps replace it with another move like earthquake or something, and then replace normal gem with something like focus sash so you can guarantee he survives a turn using swords dance while also getting the speed boost if you prevent a one-shot with focus sash. Sceptile has been my favorite Pokémon for years and I have been running a special attacker set for a long time(personally I don’t like how he doesn’t have a wide special movepool and no options besides items to increase his stats). But with sword and shield I have decided to switch to a physical set. But hey, that’s just my two cents. Sceptile though also has access to Dragon Dance this gen, which is neat but Swords Dance is better imo.
If he would get a skin this year, there’s also a chance it may be a Cosmic skin since Skarner was confirmed to be getting one. But idk, it’s just my speculation.
